-- intro: :For the similar magic used by Sivoir Snyle, see Eyeball Magic.  Eye Magic is a magic attribute that allows the user to cast enchantments through their eyes.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to cast magical enchantments through their eyes. The users are able to use this magic without the need of a grimoire. However, in order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires.
-- spell pages: Reflect Iris
